### Reshaping the data
```{r}
### Rename all CN_annot names for analysis in R
df$CN_k20_n25_annot <- gsub("B cell priming zone", "B_cell_priming_zone", df$CN_k20_n25_annot )
df$CN_k20_n25_annot <- gsub("Bulk tumor", "Bulk_tumor", df$CN_k20_n25_annot)
df$CN_k20_n25_annot <- gsub("CAF-enriched stroma", "CAF_enriched_stroma", df$CN_k20_n25_annot)
df$CN_k20_n25_annot <- gsub("Granulocyte-enriched", "Granulocyte_enriched", df$CN_k20_n25_annot)
df$CN_k20_n25_annot <- gsub("Myeloid-cell enriched immune infiltrate", "Myeloid_cell_enriched_immune_infiltrate", df$CN_k20_n25_annot )
df$CN_k20_n25_annot  <- gsub("Plasma-cell enriched immune infiltrate", "Plasma_cell_enriched_immune_infiltrate", df$CN_k20_n25_annot )
df$CN_k20_n25_annot <- gsub("T cell priming and activation", "Tcell_priming_and_activation", df$CN_k20_n25_annot )
df$CN_k20_n25_annot <- gsub("Tumor boundary", "Tumor_boundary", df$CN_k20_n25_annot )
df$CN_k20_n25_annot <- gsub("Vessel-enriched stroma", "Vessel_enriched_stroma", df$CN_k20_n25_annot)

df$cell_types_lowres <- gsub("B lymphocytes", "B_lymphocytes", df$cell_types_lowres )
df$cell_types_lowres <- gsub("T lymphocytes", "T_lymphocytes", df$cell_types_lowres)
df$cell_types_lowres <- gsub("other leukocytes", "other_leukocytes", df$cell_types_lowres)
df$cell_types_lowres <- gsub("myeloid cells", "myeloid_cells", df$cell_types_lowres)
```

# Supplementary Figure 8D+E
```{r}
## Supplementary Figure 8E
df_filt <- df %>% 
  filter(cell_types_mediumres == "CD8T")

relative_abundance <- df_filt %>%
  group_by(CN_k20_n25_annot, T_cell_memory) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  group_by(CN_k20_n25_annot) %>%
  mutate(relative_abundance = count / sum(count)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Prepare data for heatmap plotting
heatmap_data <- relative_abundance %>%
  dplyr::select(CN_k20_n25_annot, T_cell_memory, relative_abundance) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = CN_k20_n25_annot, values_from = relative_abundance, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("T_cell_memory")

# Plot the heatmap
log_normalize_row <- function(row) {
  log1p(row)  # log1p is log(1 + x)
}

log_normalized_data <- t(apply(heatmap_data, 1, log_normalize_row))
rownames(log_normalized_data) <- rownames(heatmap_data)
colnames(log_normalized_data) <- colnames(heatmap_data)

min_max_normalize_row <- function(row) {
  (row - min(row)) / (max(row) - min(row))
}

normalized_data <- t(apply(heatmap_data, 1, min_max_normalize_row))
rownames(normalized_data) <- rownames(heatmap_data)
colnames(normalized_data) <- colnames(heatmap_data)

heatmap_data$T_cell_memory <- NA
heatmap_data$T_cell_memory <- rownames(heatmap_data)

output_dir <- "/Users/maxhaist/Nolan Lab Dropbox/Maximilian Haist/MCC_project/Output_R_analysis/CT_per_CN/Features_per_CN/T_cell_memory"

# Plot the heatmap
heatmap_matrix <- as.matrix(normalized_data)
ht <- Heatmap(heatmap_matrix, name = "Minmax normalized abundnace", 
        column_title = "Cellular neighborhood", row_title = "T cell phenotype",
        heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Minmax normalized abundnace"))
ht
ht
pdf(file=paste0(output_dir, "/T_cell_memory_CD8T_phenotypes_perCN", "complexHeatmap" ,".pdf"))
 draw(ht)
 dev.off()
 print(ht)

## Supplementary Figure 8D 
 
df_filt_expression <- df_filt %>%
  dplyr::select(CD45RA, CD45RO, `TCF1/7`, GranzymeB, CCL5, CXCR3, `PD-1`, LAG3, CN_k20_n25)


mean_expression <- df_filt_expression %>%
  group_by(CN_k20_n25) %>%
  summarize(
    CD45RA_mean = mean(CD45RA, na.rm = TRUE),
    CD45RO_mean = mean(CD45RO, na.rm = TRUE),
    TCF17_mean = mean(`TCF1/7`, na.rm = TRUE),
    GranzymeB_mean = mean(GranzymeB, na.rm = TRUE),
    CCL5_mean = mean(CCL5, na.rm = TRUE),
    CXCR3_mean = mean(CXCR3, na.rm = TRUE),
    LAG3_mean = mean(LAG3, na.rm = TRUE),
    PD1_mean = mean(`PD-1`, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Z-normalize the mean expression values
z_normalized <- mean_expression %>%
  mutate(across(CD45RA_mean:PD1_mean, scale))

# Convert to a matrix for the heatmap
z_matrix <- as.matrix(z_normalized %>% dplyr::select(-CN_k20_n25))
rownames(z_matrix) <- mean_expression$CN_k20_n25


ht2 <- Heatmap(z_matrix,
        row_km = 3,
        column_km = 2, 
          top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(foo = anno_block(gp = gpar(fill = 3:2),
        labels = c("Naive-like", "Effector-like"), 
        labels_gp = gpar(col = "white", fontsize = 10))),
        left_annotation = rowAnnotation(foo = anno_block(gp = gpar(fill = 9:7),
        labels = c("Tem zone", "Tscm reservoir", "Tpex zone"), 
        labels_gp = gpar(col = "white", fontsize = 10))),
        border = TRUE,
        name = "Z-score",
        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12),
        column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12),
        show_row_dend = TRUE,
        show_column_dend = TRUE,
        right_annotation = rowAnnotation(foo2 = 11:1, bar2 = anno_barplot(runif(11))),
        col = colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("blue", "white", "red")))
ht2
ht2
pdf(file=paste0(output_dir, "/T_cell_memory_CD8T_marker_phenotypes_perCN", "complexHeatmap" ,".pdf"))
 draw(ht2)
 dev.off()
 print(ht2)
```
